heroTitle: Build one consistent asset set for your game.
heroDescription: Create, refine, and manage game art in one project, so every new piece extends the same visual language.
previewAlt: A complete game asset project preview
syncTitle: One project. Every asset in sync.
syncDescription: Generate characters, objects, scenery, tilesets, and UI Set assets in one consistent style, then manage the complete set together.

characters.title: Characters
characters.description: Generate character prototypes (2/4/8-directional views), 4-16 frame animations (Idle, Walk, Attack), and bound action SFX.
characters.headline: Make your characters move

objects.title: Objects
objects.description: Generate distinctive game objects with consistent style, clear silhouettes, and the visual states needed for your world.

scenery.title: Scenery
scenery.description: Generate multi-layer backgrounds with parallax sky, wind, and foreground detail for level design.

tilesets.title: Tilesets
tilesets.description: Build reusable pixel-art tilesets for streets, interiors, terrain, and seamless game-world construction.

uiSet.title: UI Set
uiSet.description: Design cohesive health bars, inventory panels, skill icon frames, system menus, and UI Set interaction sounds.

audio.title: Game Audio & BGM
audio.description: Generate action sound effects (SFX) matched with animations, plus immersive looping background music (BGM).

workflowTitle: One workflow from idea to game-ready pipeline.
workflowDescription: Holonic Asset connects project visual context, asset prototyping, animation frame generation, and sound effect binding into one structured workflow.

projectStyle.title: Project & Style System
projectStyle.description: Define your game type, visual style, and target platform once. Every asset generated in the project follows the same style.

prototypes.title: Multi-View Prototypes
prototypes.description: Generate character and object prototypes with 2, 4, or 8-directional views (side-on, top-down, isometric) while maintaining consistent style.

animations.title: Animations & Bound SFX
animations.description: Expand prototypes into 4-16 frame action sequences (Idle, Walk, Attack) and attach generated sound effects directly to animations.

export.title: Engine-Ready Export
export.description: Export structured Spritesheets, Parallax Scenery Layers, Tilemaps, UI Set components, and audio files ready for Unity or Godot.

closingTitle: Make the first asset. Then build everything around it.
footerDescription: AI-powered game asset creation for characters, environments, UI Set assets, and consistent project libraries.

projectStory.title: Not a folder of outputs. A complete game asset library.
projectStory.description: Every project keeps the game type, platform, and visual style in one place so new assets stay consistent. Assets stay grouped by type, from characters and objects to scenery, tilesets, and UI Set assets.
projectStory.details: Keep useful details attached to every asset: canvas size, perspective, tags, scene layers, and revision history. Your library stays understandable as the game grows.
